name: VNBUSARCHIVE COLORIMETRY PRO
author: Hoyuuna
description: VNBUSARCHIVE-compliant industrial color balance: tint correction (Warm, Cool, Magenta, Green), saturation guard (10%-52%), and highlight gamut compression.

settings.title: Neutral Tint Balancer
settings.description: Neutralize warm/cool/magenta/green color casts based on midtone gray balance

settings.title: Saturation Bounds (10%-52%)
settings.description: Compress oversaturated colors and protect against pale washed out hues

settings.title: Gamut Highlight Compression
settings.description: Soft-knee gamut compression when any color channel exceeds 4% clipping at 255

settings.title: Highlight EV Bias
settings.description: Optional EV offset applied before capture to prevent sensor blowout
